parameters.name: cfg
parameters.descr: 1: tube chamber only, 2: sphere chamber only, 3: tube + sphere

parameters.name: z_c2
parameters.descr: z of chamber 2 input flange face

parameters.name: z_c2_center
parameters.descr: chamber 2 sphere centre, relative to its flange face

parameters.name: mcp_z
parameters.descr: z coord of MCP front face

parameters.name: z_end
parameters.descr: z of last chamber flange face

parameters.name: lens_gap
parameters.descr: needle tip to L1 entrance face (front plane closest to the tip)

parameters.name: z_asm
parameters.descr: model z of the assembly CAD origin (L1 front is at CAD z = -136.165 mm)

parameters.name: D1a_v
parameters.descr: deflector 1 half a potential (2D uses the mean of a and b)

parameters.name: D2a_v
parameters.descr: deflector 2 half a potential (2D uses the mean of a and b)

parameters.name: R_cross
parameters.descr: effective -1 kV screen-cross ring outer radius, fitted to the 3D potential on r = 0 and 10 mm (calibrate_2d.py; 8.485 = hub only; 3D arms reach 45.4)

parameters.name: eps_holder
parameters.descr: rel. permittivity of the MCP holder ring (Ultem 1000 polyetherimide)

parameters.name: eps_surround
parameters.descr: rel. permittivity of the MCP surround around the active area (Al2O3 ceramic)

parameters.name: N_ion
parameters.descr: number of particles released (Particle Beam release only)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.descr: particle tracing end time (3D model used 200 us)
